name: The 40 Days
source:
On a cold and snowy Christmas night, Sister Maria, chairman of a Catholic girls' college, found a baby wrapped in a white blanket. It didn't cry when she picked it up; it cooed, smiling like an angel. It had to have been a gift from God. Convinced as such, Sister Maria decided to raise it as if it were her own.

The baby grew fast into a child with strange powers. She could heal wounds and see things others couldn't. Sister Maria knew she was no ordinary kid, and so she told her to keep her powers secret.

Sixteen years later, in November, a messenger from Vatican visited.

"She's just like Jesus Christ... our Lord himself."

Those words have turned the gears of her fate.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100124105224/http://40days.chaos-island.org/story.htm]official website[/url]]
translation:
一个寒冷飘雪的圣诞夜，天主教女子学院的理事长玛丽亚修女发现了一名裹着白色毯子的婴儿。她将孩子抱起时，婴儿没有哭，只是咿呀作声，露出天使般的微笑。这一定是上帝的恩赐。玛丽亚修女深信如此，决定将孩子视如己出，亲自抚养。

婴儿很快长大，显露出奇异的能力。她能够治愈伤口，看见常人看不见的东西。玛丽亚修女知道她并非普通孩子，便叮嘱她将能力保密。

十六年后的十一月，一位来自梵蒂冈的使者到访。

“她就如同耶稣基督……我们的主亲临世间。”

这句话，转动了她命运的齿轮。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100124105224/http://40days.chaos-island.org/story.htm]官方网站[/url]]
